research: Read the strategy packet: B025 (25 Oct) used the angles youandher, livenow, giftlist and inthebox and statics bundle / concept / value / studio / gifts / checklist / colours, so no gift list, no 'one for you, one for her', no 'live now' and no walk through the box this time.

Read docs/research/2026-10-black-friday-and-bag-ads.md: bare '50% off' hooks get scrolled past, Dagne Dover / Bellroy win on packing and scenario demos, Pacsafe on 'what is different about your bag' comparisons, flat lays beat lifestyle for a handbag store; so the videos open on a moment and the sale is the last chapter.

Checked the live product page (libracases.com, 2 Nov): three pieces, the Hobo Bag with smart compartments and anti-theft design, the Crossbody for hands-free ease, the Mini Pouch for quick essentials, soft water-resistant scratch-proof leather; this gave each project a different lead feature (crossbody, anti-theft design, pouch) and three story shapes none of the earlier batches used (four places, what you carry now, the night before).

Statics: the product's last batch used no AI ad formats, so S01 takes the owner's favourite flat lay (the three pieces side by side, closed) and S02 is a format of our own, three shop tags that give each piece its job in the facts' own words (hobo for every day, crossbody to go light, pouch for quick essentials).

projects.title: One set, four stops
projects.big_idea: A day in four stops, and each stop uses a different piece of the set: the hobo out the door, the crossbody on the move, the pouch at lunch.
projects.why_new: Earlier 3-Piece Set videos were gifts, a sale announcement and a walk through the box; this one is a day told in four places, led by the crossbody, with the sale only in the last line.

chapters.text: First thing in the morning, you are out the door. Coat on, keys in your hand, and the hobo bag goes on your shoulder. It is the everyday piece of the set, with smart compartments for the things you reach for most.
Mid-morning, errands, and a coffee in one hand. This is where the crossbody earns its place. One strap across you, and the other hand is ready for whatever comes next.
It is the piece for the days you want to go light, so you only carry what you need.
Lunchtime, the cafe. The matching pouch is ideal for quick essentials, so your cards and cash stay in one place. Pay, tuck it away, and get back to lunch.
Evening, and you are home. Hobo, crossbody and pouch, all three matched, all three used today. That is the idea of a set: one day, every stop covered.

chapters.text: Picture the bag you carry now, the one you grab without thinking. One open space, and your keys, cards and phone all end up in the same spot.
Nothing wrong with that. It just means a quick search every time you need something.
Now switch to the hobo from the set. Smart compartments give each thing its own place, and the anti-theft design keeps everything secure.
Phone in one place. Cards in another. Keys where your hand expects them. Open it and everything is easy to see. Nothing is buried, so nothing needs digging for.
And the finish is different too. Soft, water-resistant, scratch-proof leather that looks beautiful season after season.
Put it on your shoulder, walk out the door, and that is the whole switch.

And you get more than the hobo. The set adds a crossbody and a matching pouch, three pieces for one price, and in the Early Black Friday sale it is sixty percent off. Free US shipping, and the sale runs until the thirtieth of November. Tap the link below.

chapters.text: Tonight is the night before a full day out. Lunch with a friend, a few errands, and an evening to finish. Time to pack, and nothing needs to be rushed.
Cards and cash go into the matching pouch first. It is ideal for quick essentials, and it keeps them together in one place.
Phone, keys and everything else go into the hobo bag, each in its own compartment. The hobo is the piece for every day.
Pouch tucked in, bag closed up, set down by the door. That is the packing done.
Morning. Take the hobo, or take the crossbody if the day calls for going light. Either way, everything is already where it belongs.
Grab it, close the door, and go. The day is long, and your bag is already sorted.
